enumeratedValue.description: Stall the start of any new channels. Executing channels are allowed to complete. Channel execution resumes when this bit is cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: CLM_0
enumeratedValue.description: A minor loop channel link made to itself goes through channel arbitration before being activated again.

enumeratedValue.name: CLM_1
enumeratedValue.description: A minor loop channel link made to itself does not go through channel arbitration before being activated again. Upon minor loop completion, the channel activates again if that channel has a minor loop channel link enabled and the link channel is itself. This effectively applies the minor loop offsets and restarts the next minor loop.

enumeratedValue.name: EMLM_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. TCDn.word2 is defined as a 32-bit NBYTES field.

enumeratedValue.name: EMLM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. TCDn.word2 is redefined to include individual enable fields, an offset field, and the NBYTES field. The individual enable fields allow the minor loop offset to be applied to the source address, the destination address, or both. The NBYTES field is reduced when either offset is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ECX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Cancel the remaining data transfer in the same fashion as the CX bit. Stop the executing channel and force the minor loop to finish. The cancel takes effect after the last write of the current read/write sequence. The ECX bit clears itself after the cancel is honored. In addition to cancelling the transfer, ECX treats the cancel as an error condition, thus updating the Error Status register (DMAx_ES) and generating an optional error interrupt.

enumeratedValue.name: CX_1
enumeratedValue.description: Cancel the remaining data transfer. Stop the executing channel and force the minor loop to finish. The cancel takes effect after the last write of the current read/write sequence. The CX bit clears itself after the cancel has been honored. This cancel retires the channel normally as if the minor loop was completed.

enumeratedValue.name: DBE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a bus error on a destination write

enumeratedValue.name: SBE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a bus error on a source read

enumeratedValue.name: SGE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DLASTSGA field. This field is checked at the beginning of a scatter/gather operation after major loop completion if TCDn_CSR[ESG] is enabled. TCDn_DLASTSGA is not on a 32 byte boundary.

enumeratedValue.name: DOE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DOFF field. TCDn_DOFF is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[DSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: DAE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_DADDR field. TCDn_DADDR is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[DSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: SOE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_SOFF field. TCDn_SOFF is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[SSIZE].

enumeratedValue.name: SAE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded error was a configuration error detected in the TCDn_SADDR field. TCDn_SADDR is inconsistent with TCDn_ATTR[SSIZE].

field.name: ERRCHN
field.description: Error Channel Number or Canceled Channel Number

enumeratedValue.name: ECX_1
enumeratedValue.description: The last recorded entry was a canceled transfer by the error cancel transfer input

enumeratedValue.name: VLD_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one ERR bit is set indicating a valid error exists that has not been cleared.

enumeratedValue.description: Channel n cannot be suspended by a higher priority channel's service request.

enumeratedValue.name: ECP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Channel n can be temporarily suspended by the service request of a higher priority channel.

enumeratedValue.name: SMOD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Source address modulo feature is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: SMOD_0x1
enumeratedValue.description: This value defines a specific address range specified to be the value after SADDR + SOFF calculation is performed on the original register value. Setting this field provides the ability to implement a circular data queue easily. For data queues requiring power-of-2 size bytes, the queue should start at a 0-modulo-size address and the SMOD field should be set to the appropriate value for the queue, freezing the desired number of upper address bits. The value programmed into this field specifies the number of lower address bits allowed to change. For a circular queue application, the SOFF is typically set to the transfer size to implement post-increment addressing with the SMOD function constraining the addresses to a 0-modulo-size range.

enumeratedValue.name: SMOD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Source address modulo feature is disabled

enumeratedValue.name: SMOD_0x1
enumeratedValue.description: This value defines a specific address range specified to be the value after SADDR + SOFF calculation is performed on the original register value. Setting this field provides the ability to implement a circular data queue easily. For data queues requiring power-of-2 size bytes, the queue should start at a 0-modulo-size address and the SMOD field should be set to the appropriate value for the queue, freezing the desired number of upper address bits. The value programmed into this field specifies the number of lower address bits allowed to change. For a circular queue application, the SOFF is typically set to the transfer size to implement post-increment addressing with the SMOD function constraining the addresses to a 0-modulo-size range.

enumeratedValue.name: WP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Write accesses are not allowed. Attempting to write to the range of addresses for which the WP bit is set results in a bus error termination of the internal cycle and no external cycle.

enumeratedValue.name: BAM_0
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding address bit in CSAR is used in the chip-select decode.

enumeratedValue.name: BAM_1
enumeratedValue.description: The corresponding address bit in CSAR is a don't care in the chip-select decode.

enumeratedValue.name: BSTW_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. Data exceeding the specified port size is broken into individual, port-sized, non-burst writes. For example, a 32-bit write to an 8-bit port takes four byte writes.

enumeratedValue.name: BSTW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. Enables burst write of data larger than the specified port size, including 32-bit writes to 8- and 16-bit ports, 16-bit writes to 8-bit ports, and line writes to 8-, 16-, and 32-bit ports.

enumeratedValue.name: BSTR_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. Data exceeding the specified port size is broken into individual, port-sized, non-burst reads. For example, a 32-bit read from an 8-bit port is broken into four 8-bit reads.

enumeratedValue.name: BSTR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. Enables data burst reads larger than the specified port size, including 32-bit reads from 8- and 16-bit ports, 16-bit reads from 8-bit ports, and line reads from 8-, 16-, and 32-bit ports.

enumeratedValue.name: PS_0
enumeratedValue.description: 32-bit port size. Valid data is sampled and driven on FB_D[31:0].

enumeratedValue.name: AA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. No internal transfer acknowledge is asserted and the cycle is terminated externally.

enumeratedValue.name: AA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. Internal transfer acknowledge is asserted as specified by WS.

enumeratedValue.name: BLS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Not shifted. Data is left-aligned on FB_AD.

enumeratedValue.name: BLS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Shifted. Data is right-aligned on FB_AD.

enumeratedValue.name: RDAH_0
enumeratedValue.description: When AA is 1b, 1 cycle. When AA is 0b, 0 cycles.

enumeratedValue.name: RDAH_1
enumeratedValue.description: When AA is 1b, 2 cycles. When AA is 0b, 1 cycle.

enumeratedValue.name: RDAH_2
enumeratedValue.description: When AA is 1b, 3 cycles. When AA is 0b, 2 cycles.

enumeratedValue.name: RDAH_3
enumeratedValue.description: When AA is 1b, 4 cycles. When AA is 0b, 3 cycles.

enumeratedValue.name: SWSEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. A number of wait states (specified by WS) are inserted before an internal transfer acknowledge is generated for all transfers.

enumeratedValue.name: SWSEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled. A number of wait states (specified by SWS) are inserted before an internal transfer acknowledge is generated for burst transfer secondary terminations.

register.name: CSPMCR

enumeratedValue.name: LK1_0
enumeratedValue.description: Register can be written by any secure privileged write.

enumeratedValue.name: LK1_1
enumeratedValue.description: Register is locked (read-only) until the next reset.

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_1
enumeratedValue.description: RAIP and RAIE register bits implemented on MUA side

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_2
enumeratedValue.description: MUA and MUB implemented with the same function. some bits in CR register are moved to CCR register.

enumeratedValue.name: FEATURE_4
enumeratedValue.description: some sync logic are deleted for synchronized MUA and MUB. RAIP and RDIP monitor Core reset instead of MU reset. Add HRIP and MURIP and their interrupt enable bits on both sides. Delete RS bit. Add COO mode in PM state.

enumeratedValue.name: Fn_0
enumeratedValue.description: Fn bit in the MUB CR register is written 0 (default).

enumeratedValue.name: Fn_1
enumeratedValue.description: Fn bit in the MUB CR register is written 1.

enumeratedValue.name: NMIC_1
enumeratedValue.description: Writing "1" clears the NMI bit in the MUB CR register.

enumeratedValue.name: EP_0
enumeratedValue.description: The MUA side event is not pending (default).

enumeratedValue.name: EP_1
enumeratedValue.description: The MUA side event is pending.

enumeratedValue.name: HRIP_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUB didn't issue hardware reset to Processor A

enumeratedValue.name: HRIP_1
enumeratedValue.description: MUB had initiated a hardware reset to Processor A through HR bit.

enumeratedValue.name: FUP_0
enumeratedValue.description: No flags updated, initiated by the MUA, in progress (default)

enumeratedValue.name: RDIP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Processor B did not exit reset

enumeratedValue.name: RAIP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Processor B did not enter reset

enumeratedValue.name: MURIP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Processor B did not issue MU reset

enumeratedValue.name: RUN
enumeratedValue.description: The MUB processor is in Run Mode.

enumeratedValue.name: COO
enumeratedValue.description: The MUB processor is in COO Mode.

enumeratedValue.name: WAIT
enumeratedValue.description: The MUB processor is in WAIT Mode.

enumeratedValue.name: TEn_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUA TRn register is not empty.

enumeratedValue.name: RFn_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUA RRn register is not full (default).

enumeratedValue.name: RFn_1
enumeratedValue.description: MUA RRn register has received data from MUB TRn register and is ready to be read by the MUA.

enumeratedValue.name: GIPn_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUA general purpose interrupt n is not pending. (default)

enumeratedValue.name: GIPn_1
enumeratedValue.description: MUA general purpose interrupt n is pending.

enumeratedValue.name: Fn_0
enumeratedValue.description: Clears the Fn bit in the SR register.

enumeratedValue.name: Fn_1
enumeratedValue.description: Sets the Fn bit in the SR register.

enumeratedValue.name: NMI_0
enumeratedValue.description: Non-maskable interrupt is not issued to the Processor B by the Processor A (default).

enumeratedValue.name: NMI_1
enumeratedValue.description: Non-maskable interrupt is issued to the Processor B by the Processor A.

enumeratedValue.name: RDIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disables Processor A General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B reset de-assertion.

enumeratedValue.name: RDIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables Processor A General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B reset de-assertion.

field.name: HRIE
field.description: Processor A hardware reset interrupt enable

enumeratedValue.name: HRIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disables Processor A General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B issued HR to Processor A.

enumeratedValue.name: HRIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables Processor A General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B issued HR to Processor A.

enumeratedValue.name: MURIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disables Processor A-side General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to MU reset issued by MUB.

enumeratedValue.name: MURIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables Processor A-side General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to MU reset issued by MUB.

enumeratedValue.name: RAIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disables Processor A-side General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B reset assertion.

enumeratedValue.name: RAIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables Processor A-side General Purpose Interrupt 3 request due to Processor B reset assertion.

enumeratedValue.name: GIRn_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUA General Interrupt n is not requested to the MUB (default).

enumeratedValue.name: GIRn_1
enumeratedValue.description: MUA General Interrupt n is requested to the MUB.

enumeratedValue.name: HR_0
enumeratedValue.description: De-assert Hardware reset to the Processor B. (default)

enumeratedValue.name: HR_1
enumeratedValue.description: Assert Hardware reset to the Processor B.

field.name: HRM
field.description: When set, HR bit in MUB CCR has no effect

enumeratedValue.name: HRM_0
enumeratedValue.description: HR bit in MUB CCR is not masked, enables the hardware reset to the Processor A (default after hardware reset).

enumeratedValue.name: HRM_1
enumeratedValue.description: HR bit in MUB CCR is masked, disables the hardware reset request to the Processor A.

enumeratedValue.name: CLKE_0
enumeratedValue.description: MUB platform clock gated when MUB-side enters a stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: CLKE_1
enumeratedValue.description: MUB platform clock kept running after MUB-side enters a stop mode, until MUA also enters a stop mode.

enumeratedValue.name: FBSL_0
enumeratedValue.description: All off-chip access(instruction and data) via the Flexbus or sdram are disallowed

enumeratedValue.name: FBSL_1
enumeratedValue.description: All off-chip access(instruction and data) via the Flexbus or sdram are disallowed

enumeratedValue.name: FBSL_2
enumeratedValue.description: off-chip instruction access are disallowed, data access are allowed

enumeratedValue.name: FBSL_3
enumeratedValue.description: off-chip instruction access and data access are allowed

enumeratedValue.name: FLASHDOZE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Flash remains enabled during Doze mode

enumeratedValue.name: FLASHDOZE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Flash is disabled for the duration of Doze mode

enumeratedValue.name: SWAP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Logical P-flash Block 0 is located at relative address 0x0000

enumeratedValue.name: SWAP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Logical P-flash Block 1 is located at relative address 0x0000

enumeratedValue.name: MSBF_1
enumeratedValue.description: MSB (bit9, bit8, bit7 or bit6) is the first bit that is transmitted following the start bit depending on the setting of CTRL[M], CTRL[PE] and BAUD[M10]. enumeratedValue.description: CTS has no effect on the transmitter.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables clear-to-send operation. The transmitter checks the state of CTS each time it is ready to send a character. If CTS is asserted, the character is sent. If CTS is deasserted, the signal TXD remains in the mark state and transmission is delayed until CTS is asserted. Changes in CTS as a character is being sent do not affect its transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: TXRTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: When a character is placed into an empty transmitter data buffer , RTS asserts one bit time before the start bit is transmitted. enumeratedValue.name: CS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Digital filters are clocked by the bus clock.

enumeratedValue.name: RES_0
enumeratedValue.description: Up to 13-bit differential/12-bit single ended resolution supported.

enumeratedValue.name: RES_1
enumeratedValue.description: Up to 16-bit differential/15-bit single ended resolution supported.

enumeratedValue.name: DIFFEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Differential operation supported. CMDLa[DIFF] and CMDLa[ABSEL] control fields implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: MVI_0
enumeratedValue.description: Single voltage reference high (VREFH) input supported.

enumeratedValue.name: MVI_1
enumeratedValue.description: Multiple voltage reference high (VREFH) inputs supported.

enumeratedValue.name: CSW_1
enumeratedValue.description: Channel scaling supported. 1-bit CSCALE control field.

enumeratedValue.name: CSW_6
enumeratedValue.description: Channel scaling supported. 6-bit CSCALE control field.

field.name: VR1RNGI
field.description: Voltage Reference 1 Range Control Bit Implemented

enumeratedValue.name: VR1RNGI_0
enumeratedValue.description: Range control not required. CFG[VREF1RNG] is not implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: VR1RNGI_1
enumeratedValue.description: Range control required. CFG[VREF1RNG] is implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: CALOFSI_0
enumeratedValue.description: Offset calibration and offset trimming not implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: CALOFSI_1
enumeratedValue.description: Offset calibration and offset trimming implemented.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: ADC is enabled in Doze mode.

enumeratedValue.name: DOZEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: ADC is disabled in Doze mode.

enumeratedValue.name: RDY_0
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO data level not above watermark level.

enumeratedValue.name: RDY_1
enumeratedValue.description: Result FIFO holding data above watermark level.

enumeratedValue.name: FOF_0
enumeratedValue.description: No result FIFO overflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: FOF_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one result FIFO overflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) associated with Trigger 0 currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) associated with Trigger 1 currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGACT_3
enumeratedValue.description: Command (sequence) associated with Trigger 3 currently being executed.

enumeratedValue.name: CMDACT_0
enumeratedValue.description: No command is currently in progress.

enumeratedValue.name: FWMIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO watermark interrupts are not enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: FOFIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO overflow interrupts are not enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TPRICTRL_0
enumeratedValue.description: If a higher priority trigger is detected during command processing, the current conversion is aborted and the new command specified by the trigger is started.

enumeratedValue.name: TPRICTRL_1
enumeratedValue.description: If a higher priority trigger is received during command processing, the current conversion is completed (including averaging iterations and compare function if enabled) and stored to the RESFIFO before the higher priority trigger/command is initiated.

enumeratedValue.name: PWREN_0
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are only enabled while conversions are active. Performance is affected due to analog startup delays.

enumeratedValue.name: PWREN_1
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays (at the cost of higher DC current consumption). When PWREN is set, the power up delay is enforced such that any detected trigger does not begin ADC operation until the power up delay time has passed.

field.name: VREF1RNG
field.description: Enable support for low voltage reference on Option 1 Reference

enumeratedValue.name: VREF1RNG_0
enumeratedValue.description: Configuration required when Voltage Reference Option 1 input is in high voltage range

enumeratedValue.name: VREF1RNG_1
enumeratedValue.description: Configuration required when Voltage Reference Option 1 input is in low voltage range

enumeratedValue.name: ADCKEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are only enabled while conversions are active. Performance is affected due to analog startup delays.

enumeratedValue.name: ADCKEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: ADC analog circuits are pre-enabled and ready to execute conversions without startup delays (at the cost of higher DC current consumption).

enumeratedValue.name: TCMD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Not a valid selection from the command buffer. Trigger event is ignored.

enumeratedValue.description: Compare enabled. Repeat channel acquisition (sample/convert/compare) until true.

enumeratedValue.name: VALID_1

field.name: MINOR
field.description: Minor Version Number. This read only field returns the minor version number for the module specification.

field.name: MAJOR
field.description: Major Version Number. This read only field returns the major version number for the module specification.

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_STOP_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Comparator is disabled in STOP modes regardless of CMP_EN.

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_STOP_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Comparator is enabled in STOP mode if CMP_EN is active

enumeratedValue.name: COUT_INV_0
enumeratedValue.description: Does not invert the comparator output.

enumeratedValue.name: COUT_SEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Set CMPO to equal COUT (filtered comparator output).

enumeratedValue.name: COUT_SEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Set CMPO to equal COUTA (unfiltered comparator output).

enumeratedValue.name: FILT_CNT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Filter is disabled. If SAMPLE_EN = 1, then COUT is a logic zero (this is not a legal state, and is not recommended). If SAMPLE_EN = 0, COUT = COUTA.

enumeratedValue.name: FILT_CNT_1
enumeratedValue.description: 1 consecutive sample must agree (comparator output is simply sampled).

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_HPMD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Low speed comparison mode is selected.(when CMP_NPMD is 0)

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_HPMD_1
enumeratedValue.description: High speed comparison mode is selected.(when CMP_NPMD is 0)

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_NPMD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Nano Power Comparator is not enabled (mode is determined by CMP_HPMD)

field.name: HYSTCTR
field.description: Comparator hard block hysteresis control. See chip data sheet to get the actual hystersis value with each level

enumeratedValue.name: HYSTCTR_0
enumeratedValue.description: The hard block output has level 0 hysteresis internally.

enumeratedValue.name: HYSTCTR_1
enumeratedValue.description: The hard block output has level 1 hysteresis internally.

enumeratedValue.name: HYSTCTR_2
enumeratedValue.description: The hard block output has level 2 hysteresis internally.

enumeratedValue.name: HYSTCTR_3
enumeratedValue.description: The hard block output has level 3 hysteresis internally.

enumeratedValue.name: DAC_LPMD_0
enumeratedValue.description: DAC low power mode is not enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: DAC_LPMD_1
enumeratedValue.description: DAC low power mode is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: VRSEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: vrefh_int is selected as resistor ladder network supply reference Vin.

enumeratedValue.name: VRSEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: vrefh_ext is selected as resistor ladder network supply reference Vin.

enumeratedValue.name: CFR_0
enumeratedValue.description: A rising edge has not been detected on COUT.

enumeratedValue.name: CFR_1
enumeratedValue.description: A rising edge on COUT has occurred.

enumeratedValue.name: CFF_0
enumeratedValue.description: A falling edge has not been detected on COUT.

enumeratedValue.name: CFF_1
enumeratedValue.description: A falling edge on COUT has occurred.

field.name: DATA
field.description: In FIFO mode or swing back mode, this is the FIFO data entry. In buffer mode, write to this field will push the data to analog without trigger support. This field is write only and always read zero.

enumeratedValue.name: DACRFS_0
enumeratedValue.description: The DAC selects VREFH_INT as the reference voltage.

enumeratedValue.name: DACRFS_1
enumeratedValue.description: The DAC selects VREFH_EXT as the reference voltage.

enumeratedValue.name: FIFOEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO mode is disabled and buffer mode is enabled. Any data written to DATA[DATA] goes to buffer then goes to conversion.

enumeratedValue.name: FIFOEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO mode is enabled. Data will be first read from FIFO to buffer then goes to conversion

enumeratedValue.name: TRGSEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: The DAC hardware trigger is selected.

enumeratedValue.name: TRGSEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: The DAC software trigger is selected.

enumeratedValue.name: WM_0
enumeratedValue.description: Data in FIFO is more than watermark level

enumeratedValue.name: WM_1
enumeratedValue.description: Data in FIFO is less than or equal to watermark level

field.name: SWBK
field.description: Swing Back One Cycle Complete Flag

enumeratedValue.name: SWBK_0
enumeratedValue.description: No swing back cycle has completed since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: SWBK_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one swing back cycle has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: OF_0
enumeratedValue.description: No overflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: OF_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one FIFO overflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: UF_0
enumeratedValue.description: No underflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: UF_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one trigger underflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

field.name: SWBK_IE
field.description: Swing back One Cycle Complete Interrupt Enable

enumeratedValue.name: SWBK_IE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Swing back one time complete interrupt is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: SWBK_IE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Swing back one time complete interrupt is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: EMPTY_DMAEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO Empty DMA request is disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: EMPTY_DMAEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: FIFO Empty DMA request is enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: SWTRG_0
enumeratedValue.description: The DAC soft trigger is not valid.

enumeratedValue.name: SWTRG_1
enumeratedValue.description: The DAC soft trigger is valid.

field.name: CHOPEN
field.description: Chop oscillator enable. When set, the internal chopping operation is enabled and the internal analog offset will be minimized.

enumeratedValue.name: MODE_LV_0
enumeratedValue.description: Bandgap on only, for stabilization and startup

enumeratedValue.name: VREFST_0
enumeratedValue.description: The module is disabled or not stable.

enumeratedValue.name: SAMP_MODE_0
enumeratedValue.description: use Von Neumann data into both Entropy shifter and Statistical Checker

enumeratedValue.name: SAMP_MODE_1
enumeratedValue.description: use raw data into both Entropy shifter and Statistical Checker

enumeratedValue.name: SAMP_MODE_2
enumeratedValue.description: use Von Neumann data into Entropy shifter. Use raw data into Statistical Checker

enumeratedValue.name: OSC_DIV_0
enumeratedValue.description: use ring oscillator with no divide

field.name: UNUSED
field.description: This bit is unused but write-able. Must be left as zero.

field.name: FCT_VAL
field.description: Read only: Frequency Count Valid. Indicates that a valid frequency count may be read from FRQCNT.

field.name: TST_OUT

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_3
enumeratedValue.description: 011b - Match is enabled, if any data word equals MATCH0 OR MATCH1, i.e., (any data word = MATCH0 + MATCH1)

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_4
enumeratedValue.description: 100b - Match is enabled, if 1st data word equals MATCH0 AND 2nd data word equals MATCH1, i.e., [(1st data word = MATCH0) * (2nd data word = MATCH1)]

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_5
enumeratedValue.description: 101b - Match is enabled, if any data word equals MATCH0 AND the next data word equals MATCH1, i.e., [(any data word = MATCH0) * (next data word = MATCH1)]

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_6
enumeratedValue.description: 110b - Match is enabled, if (1st data word AND MATCH1) equals (MATCH0 AND MATCH1), i.e., [(1st data word * MATCH1) = (MATCH0 * MATCH1)]

enumeratedValue.name: MATCFG_7
enumeratedValue.description: 111b - Match is enabled, if (any data word AND MATCH1) equals (MATCH0 AND MATCH1), i.e., [(any data word * MATCH1) = (MATCH0 * MATCH1)]

enumeratedValue.description: LIN break detect is disabled, normal break character can be detected.

enumeratedValue.name: LBKDE_1
enumeratedValue.description: LIN break detect is enabled. LIN break character is detected at length of 11 bit times (if M = 0) or 12 (if M = 1) or 13 (M10 = 1).

enumeratedValue.name: BRK13_0
enumeratedValue.description: Break character is transmitted with length of 9 to 13 bit times.

enumeratedValue.name: BRK13_1
enumeratedValue.description: Break character is transmitted with length of 12 to 15 bit times.

enumeratedValue.name: RWUID_0
enumeratedValue.description: During receive standby state (RWU = 1), the IDLE bit does not get set upon detection of an idle character. During address match wakeup, the IDLE bit does not set when an address does not match.

enumeratedValue.name: RWUID_1
enumeratedValue.description: During receive standby state (RWU = 1), the IDLE bit gets set upon detection of an idle character. During address match wakeup, the IDLE bit does set when an address does not match.

enumeratedValue.name: MSBF_0
enumeratedValue.description: LSB (bit0) is the first bit that is transmitted following the start bit. Further, the first bit received after the start bit is identified as bit0.

enumeratedValue.name: MSBF_1
enumeratedValue.description: MSB (bit9, bit8, bit7 or bit6) is the first bit that is transmitted following the start bit depending on the setting of CTRL[M], CTRL[PE] and BAUD[M10]. Further, the first bit received after the start bit is identified as bit9, bit8, bit7 or bit6 depending on the setting of CTRL[M] and CTRL[PE].

enumeratedValue.name: RXEDGIF_1

enumeratedValue.name: LBKDIF_0
enumeratedValue.description: No LIN break character has been detected.

enumeratedValue.name: LBKDIF_1
enumeratedValue.description: LIN break character has been detected.

enumeratedValue.name: RSRC_1

enumeratedValue.name: LOOPS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Loop mode or single-wire mode where transmitter outputs are internally connected to receiver input (see RSRC bit).

enumeratedValue.name: M7_0
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver and transmitter use 8-bit to 10-bit data characters.

enumeratedValue.name: M7_1
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver and transmitter use 7-bit data characters.

enumeratedValue.name: SBK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Queue break character(s) to be sent.

enumeratedValue.name: RWU_1
enumeratedValue.description: LPUART receiver in standby waiting for wakeup condition.

enumeratedValue.name: ILIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupts from IDLE disabled; use polling.

enumeratedValue.name: ILIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt requested when IDLE flag is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: RIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupts from RDRF disabled; use polling.

enumeratedValue.name: RIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt requested when RDRF flag is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: TCIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupts from TC disabled; use polling.

enumeratedValue.name: TCIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt requested when TC flag is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: TIE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupts from TDRE disabled; use polling.

enumeratedValue.name: TIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt requested when TDRE flag is 1.

enumeratedValue.name: PEIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt requested when PF is set.

enumeratedValue.name: FEIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt requested when FE is set.

enumeratedValue.name: NEIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt requested when NF is set.

enumeratedValue.name: ORIE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Hardware interrupt requested when OR is set.

field.name: TXDIR
field.description: TXD Pin Direction in Single-Wire Mode

enumeratedValue.name: TXDIR_0
enumeratedValue.description: TXD pin is an input in single-wire mode.

enumeratedValue.name: TXDIR_1
enumeratedValue.description: TXD pin is an output in single-wire mode.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLINE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver was not idle before receiving this character.

enumeratedValue.name: IDLINE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Receiver was idle before receiving this character.

enumeratedValue.name: RXEMPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Receive buffer is empty, data returned on read is not valid.

enumeratedValue.name: FRETSC_0
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword was received without a frame error on read, or transmit a normal character on write.

enumeratedValue.name: FRETSC_1
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword was received with a frame error, or transmit an idle or break character on transmit.

enumeratedValue.name: PARITYE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword was received without a parity error.

enumeratedValue.name: PARITYE_1
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword was received with a parity error.

enumeratedValue.name: NOISY_0
enumeratedValue.description: The dataword was received without noise.

enumeratedValue.name: NOISY_1
enumeratedValue.description: The data was received with noise.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: CTS has no effect on the transmitter.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enables clear-to-send operation. The transmitter checks the state of CTS each time it is ready to send a character. If CTS is asserted, the character is sent. If CTS is deasserted, the signal TXD remains in the mark state and transmission is delayed until CTS is asserted. Changes in CTS as a character is being sent do not affect its transmission.

enumeratedValue.name: TXRTSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The transmitter has no effect on RTS.

enumeratedValue.name: TXRTSE_1
enumeratedValue.description: When a character is placed into an empty transmitter data buffer , RTS asserts one bit time before the start bit is transmitted. RTS deasserts one bit time after all characters in the transmitter data buffer and shift register are completely sent, including the last stop bit.

enumeratedValue.name: RXRTSE_0
enumeratedValue.description: The receiver has no effect on RTS.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSC_0
enumeratedValue.description: CTS input is sampled at the start of each character.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSC_1
enumeratedValue.description: CTS input is sampled when the transmitter is idle.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSSRC_0
enumeratedValue.description: CTS input is the CTS_B pin.

enumeratedValue.name: TXCTSSRC_1
enumeratedValue.description: CTS input is the inverted Receiver Match result.

enumeratedValue.name: RXFE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Receive FIFO is not enabled. Buffer is depth 1. (Legacy support)

enumeratedValue.name: RXFE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Receive FIFO is enabled. Buffer is depth indicted by RXFIFOSIZE.

enumeratedValue.name: TXFE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO is not enabled. Buffer is depth 1. (Legacy support).

enumeratedValue.name: TXFE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Transmit FIFO is enabled. Buffer is depth indicated by TXFIFOSIZE.

enumeratedValue.name: RXUFE_0
enumeratedValue.description: RXUF flag does not generate an interrupt to the host.

enumeratedValue.name: RXUFE_1
enumeratedValue.description: RXUF flag generates an interrupt to the host.

enumeratedValue.name: TXOFE_0
enumeratedValue.description: TXOF flag does not generate an interrupt to the host.

enumeratedValue.name: TXOFE_1
enumeratedValue.description: TXOF flag generates an interrupt to the host.

enumeratedValue.name: RXIDEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle.

enumeratedValue.name: RXIDEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle for 1 character.

enumeratedValue.name: RXIDEN_2
enumeratedValue.description: Enable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle for 2 characters.

enumeratedValue.name: RXIDEN_3
enumeratedValue.description: Enable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle for 4 characters.

enumeratedValue.name: RXIDEN_4
enumeratedValue.description: Enable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle for 8 characters.

enumeratedValue.name: RXIDEN_5
enumeratedValue.description: Enable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle for 16 characters.

enumeratedValue.name: RXIDEN_6
enumeratedValue.description: Enable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle for 32 characters.

enumeratedValue.name: RXIDEN_7
enumeratedValue.description: Enable RDRF assertion due to partially filled FIFO when receiver is idle for 64 characters.

enumeratedValue.name: RXFLUSH_1
enumeratedValue.description: All data in the receive FIFO/buffer is cleared out.

enumeratedValue.name: TXFLUSH_1
enumeratedValue.description: All data in the transmit FIFO/Buffer is cleared out.

enumeratedValue.name: RXUF_0
enumeratedValue.description: No receive buffer underflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: RXUF_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one receive buffer underflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: TXOF_0
enumeratedValue.description: No transmit buffer overflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

enumeratedValue.name: TXOF_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one transmit buffer overflow has occurred since the last time the flag was cleared.

field.name: MINOR
field.description: Minor Version Number. This read only field returns the minor version number for the module specification.

field.name: MAJOR
field.description: Major Version Number. This read only field returns the major version number for the module specification.

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_STOP_EN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Comparator is disabled in STOP modes regardless of CMP_EN.

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_STOP_EN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Comparator is enabled in STOP mode if CMP_EN is active

enumeratedValue.name: COUT_INV_0
enumeratedValue.description: Does not invert the comparator output.

enumeratedValue.name: COUT_SEL_0
enumeratedValue.description: Set CMPO to equal COUT (filtered comparator output).

enumeratedValue.name: COUT_SEL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Set CMPO to equal COUTA (unfiltered comparator output).

enumeratedValue.name: FILT_CNT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Filter is disabled. If SAMPLE_EN = 1, then COUT is a logic zero (this is not a legal state, and is not recommended). If SAMPLE_EN = 0, COUT = COUTA.

enumeratedValue.name: FILT_CNT_1
enumeratedValue.description: 1 consecutive sample must agree (comparator output is simply sampled).

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_HPMD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Low speed comparison mode is selected.(when CMP_NPMD is 0)

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_HPMD_1
enumeratedValue.description: High speed comparison mode is selected.(when CMP_NPMD is 0)

enumeratedValue.name: CMP_NPMD_0
enumeratedValue.description: Nano Power Comparator is not enabled (mode is determined by CMP_HPMD)

field.name: HYSTCTR

field.name: STIMENA
field.description: For bit STIMENA[n], in register ITM_TERx:0 = Stimulus port (32x + n) disabled1 = Stimulus port (32x + n) enabled

field.name: PRIVMASK
field.description: Bit mask to enable tracing on ITM stimulus ports:Bit [0] = stimulus port [7:0]Bit [1] = stimulus port [15:8]Bit [2] = stimulus port [23:16]Bit [3] = stimulus port [31:24]

enumeratedValue.name: SWOENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp counter uses the processor system clock.

enumeratedValue.name: SWOENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp counter uses asynchronous clock from the TPIU interface.

field.name: TSPrescale
field.description: Local timestamp prescaler, used with the trace packet reference clock.

field.name: GTSFREQ
field.description: Global timestamp frequency. Defines how often the ITM generates a global timestamp, based on the global timestamp clock frequency, or disables generation of global timestamps.

enumeratedValue.name: GTSFREQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: Generate timestamp request whenever the ITM detects a change in global timestamp counter bits [47:7]. This is approximately every 128 cycles.

enumeratedValue.name: GTSFREQ_2
enumeratedValue.description: Generate timestamp request whenever the ITM detects a change in global timestamp counter bits [47:13]. This is approximately every 8192 cycles.

enumeratedValue.name: GTSFREQ_3
enumeratedValue.description: Generate a timestamp after every packet, if the output FIFO is empty.

field.name: TraceBusID
field.description: Identifier for multi-source trace stream formatting. If multi-source trace is in use, the debugger must write a non-zero value to this field.

field.name: BUSY
field.description: Indicates whether the ITM is currently processing events:0: ITM is not processing any events.1: ITM events present and being drained.

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY_0
enumeratedValue.description: ITM is not processing any events.

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY_1
enumeratedValue.description: ITM events present and beeing drained.

field.name: WriteAccessCode
field.description: Write Access Code. A write of 0xC5ACCE55 enables further write access to this device. An invalid write will have the affect of removing write access.

field.name: IMP
field.description: Lock mechanism is implemented. This bit always reads 1.

field.name: STATUS
field.description: Lock Status. This bit is HIGH when the device is locked, and LOW when unlocked.

field.name: s8BIT
field.description: Access Lock Register size. This bit reads 0 to indicate a 32-bit register is present.

peripheral.name: DWT
peripheral.description: Data Watchpoint and Trace Unit Registers

field.name: CYCCNTENA
field.description: CYCCNTENA bit. Enables CYCCNT.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: POSTPRESET
field.description: POSTPRESET bits. Reload value for the POSTCNT counter. This field is UNK/SBZP if the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: POSTINIT
field.description: POSTINIT bits. Initial value for the POSTCNT counter. This field is UNK/SBZP if the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: CYCTAP
field.description: CYCTAP bit. Selects the position of the POSTCNT tap on the CYCCNT counter.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: SYNCTAP
field.description: SYNCTAP bits. Selects the position of the synchronization packet counter tap on the CYCCNT counter. This determines the Synchronization packet rate.

field.name: PCSAMPLENA
field.description: PCSAMPLENA bit. Enables use of POSTCNT counter as a timer for Periodic PC sample packet generation.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOTRCPKT bit is RAO or the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: PCSAMPLENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: No Periodic PC sample packets generated.

field.name: EXCTRCENA
field.description: EXCTRCENA bit. Enables generation of exception trace.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOTRCPKT bit is RAO.

field.name: CPIEVTENA
field.description: CPIEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the CPI counter overflow event.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: EXCEVTENA
field.description: EXCEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the Exception overhead counter overflow event.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: SLEEPEVTENA
field.description: SLEEPEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the Sleep counter overflow event.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: LSUEVTENA
field.description: LSUEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the LSU counter overflow event.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: FOLDEVTENA
field.description: FOLDEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the Folded-instruction counter overflow event.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: CYCEVTENA
field.description: CYCEVTENA bit. Enables POSTCNT underflow Event counter packets generation.This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOTRCPKT bit is RAO or the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCEVTENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: POSTCNT underflow packets generated, if PCSAMPLENA set to 0.

field.name: NOPFRCNT
field.description: NOPFRCNT bit. Shows whether the implementation supports the profiling counters.

field.name: NOCYCCNT
field.description: NOCYCCNT bit. Shows whether the implementation supports a cycle counter.

field.name: NOEXTTRIG
field.description: NOEXTRRIG bit. Shows whether the implementation includes external match signals, CMPMATCH[N].

field.name: NOTRCPKT
field.description: NOTRCPKT bit. Shows whether the implementation supports trace sampling and exception tracing.If this bit is RAZ, the NOCYCCNT bit must also RAZ.

enumeratedValue.name: NOTRCPKT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Trace sampling and exception tracing supported.

enumeratedValue.name: NOTRCPKT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Trace sampling and exception tracing not supported.

field.name: NUMCOMP
field.description: NUMCOMP bits. Number of comparators implemented.A value of zero indicates no comparator support.

field.name: CYCCNT
field.description: CYCCNT[31:0]. Incrementing cycle counter value. When enabled, CYCCNT increments on each processor clock cycle. On overflow, CYCCNT wraps to zero.

field.name: CPICNT
field.description: CPICNT[7:0]. The base CPI counter. Counts additional cycles required to execute multi-cycle instructions, except those recorded by DWT_LSUCNT, and counts any instruction fetch stalls.

field.name: EXCCNT
field.description: EXCCNT[7:0]. The exception overhead counter. Counts the total cycles spent in exception processing.

field.name: SLEEPCNT
field.description: SLEEPCNT[7:0]. Sleep counter. Counts the total number of cycles that the processor is sleeping.

field.name: LSUCNT
field.description: LSUCNT[7:0]. Load-store counter. Increments on any additional cycles required to execute load or store instructions.

field.name: FOLDCNT
field.description: FOLDCNT[7:0]. Folded-instruction counter. Increments on each instruction that takes 0 cycles.

field.name: EIASAMPLE
field.description: EIASAMPLE[31:0]. Executed Instruction Address sample value.

field.name: MASK
field.description: MASK[4:0]. The size of the ignore mask, 0-31 bits, applied to address range matching.The maximum mask size is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED. A debugger can write 0b11111 to this field and then read the register back to determine the maximum mask size supported.

field.name: FUNCTION
field.description: FUNCTION[3:0]. Selects action taken on comparator match.This field resets to zero.

field.name: EMITRANGE
field.description: EMITRANGE bit. If the implementation supports trace sampling, enables generation of Data trace address offset packets, that hold Daddr[15:0].If DWT_CTRL.NOTRCPKT is RAZ then this bit is UNK/SBZP.

enumeratedValue.name: EMITRANGE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Data trace address offset packets disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: EMITRANGE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable Data trace address offset packet generation.

field.name: CYCMATCH
field.description: CYCMATCH bit. If the implementation supports cycle counting, enable cycle count comparison for comparator 0.If DWT_CTRL.NOCYCCNT is RAZ then this bit is UNK/SBZP.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCMATCH_1
enumeratedValue.description: Compare DWT_COMP0 with the cycle counter, DWT_CYCCNT.

field.name: DATAVMATCH
field.description: DATAVMATCH bit. Enables data value comparison, if supported.For comparator 0, when the CYCMATCH is set to 1, DATAVMATCH must be set to 0 for it to perform cycle count comparison.See LNK1ENA, DATAVSIZE, DATAVADDR0 and DATAVADDR1 for related information.If the implementation does not support data value comparison this bit is RAZ/WI.

field.name: LNK1ENA
field.description: LNK1ENA bit. Indicates whether the implementation supports use of a second linked comparator.When LNK1ENA is RAO, the DATAVADDR1 field specifies the comparator to use as the second linked comparator.

field.name: DATAVSIZE
field.description: DATAVSIZE[1:0]. For data value matching, specifies the size of the required data comparison.

field.name: DATAVADDR0
field.description: DATAVADDR0[3:0]. When the DATAVMATCH bit is set to 1 this field can hold the comparator number of a comparator to use for linked address comparison. The DWT unit ignores the value of this field if the DATAVMATCH bit is set to 0.

field.name: DATAVADDR1
field.description: DATAVADDR1[3:0]. When the DATAVMATCH and LNK1ENA bits are both 1, this field can hold the comparator number of a second comparator to use for linked address comparison. The DWT unit ignores the value of this field unless the LNK1ENA bit is RAO and the DATAVMATCH bit is set to 1.If LNK1ENA is RAZ, this field is RAZ/WI.

field.name: MATCHED
field.description: MATCHED bit. Comparator match.A value of 1 indicates that the operation defined by the FUNCTION field occurred since the last read of the register.Reading the register clears this bit to 0.

peripheral.name: FPB
peripheral.description: Flash Patch and Breakpoint Unit Registers

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable bit for the FPB.A Power-on reset clears this bit to 0.

field.name: KEY
field.description: KEY bit. On any write to FP_CTRL, the FPB unit ignores the write unless this bit is 1. This bit is RAZ.

field.name: NUM_CODE_least
field.description: NUM_CODE[3:0]. The least significant bits of NUM_CODE, the number of instruction address comparators.If NUM_CODE[6:0] is zero, the implementation does not support any instruction address comparators.

field.name: NUM_LIT
field.description: NUM_LIT bits. The number of literal address comparators supported.If this field is zero, the implementation does not support literal comparators.

field.name: NUM_CODE_most
field.description: NUM_CODE[6:4]. The most significant bits of NUM_CODE, the number of instruction address comparators, see bits [7:4].

field.name: REMAP
field.description: REMAP bits. If the FPB supports flash patch remap, this field:- holds bits [28:5] of the base address in SRAM to which the FPB remaps the address- has an UNKNOWN value on reset.If the FPB only supports breakpoint functionality this field is UNK/SBZP.

field.name: RMPSPT
field.description: RMPSPT bit. Indicates whether the FPB unit supports flash patch remap.

enumeratedValue.name: RMPSPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Remapping not supported. The FPB only supports breakpoint functionality.

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable bit for this comparator.A Power-on reset clears this bit to 0.

field.name: COMP
field.description: COMP bits. Bits [28:2] of the address to compare with addresses from the Code memory region. Bits [31:29] and [1:0] of the address for comparison are zero.If a match occurs:- for an instruction address comparator, the REPLACE field defines the required action- for a literal address comparator, the FPB remaps the access.The reset value of this field is UNKNOWN.

field.name: REPLACE
field.description: REPLACE[1:0]. For an instruction address comparator:- Defines the behavior when the COMP address is matched.- The reset value of this field is UNKNOWN.For a literal address comparator:- Field is UNK/SBZP.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Breakpoint on lower halfword, upper is unaffected.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Breakpoint on upper halfword, lower is unaffected.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Breakpoint on both lower and upper halfwords.

register.name: DHCSR_Read
register.description: Debug Halting Control and Status Register

field.name: C_DEBUGEN
field.description: Halting debug enable bit. If a debugger writes to DHCSR to change the value of this bit from 0 to 1, it must also write 0 to the C_MASKINTS bit, otherwise behavior is UNPREDICTABLE.This bit can only be set to 1 from the DAP, it cannot be set to 1 under software control.This bit is 0 after a Power-on reset.

field.name: C_HALT
field.description: Processor halt bit. This bit is UNKNOWN after a Power-on reset.

field.name: C_STEP
field.description: Processor step bit.This bit is UNKNOWN after a Power-on reset.

field.name: C_MASKINTS
field.description: C_MASKINTS bit. When debug is enabled, the debugger can write to this bit to mask PendSV, SysTick and external configurable interrupts. The effect of any attempt to change the value of this bit is UNPREDICTABLE unless both:- before the write to DHCSR, the value of the C_HALT bit is 1.- the write to the DHCSR that changes the C_MASKINTS bit also writes 1 to the C_HALT bit.This means that a single write to DHCSR cannot set the C_HALT to 0 and change the value of the C_MASKINTS bit.The bit does not affect NMI. When DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the value of this bit is UNKNOWN.This bit is UNKNOWN after a Power-on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: C_MASKINTS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Mask PenSV, SysTick and external configurable interrupts.

field.name: C_SNAPSTALL
field.description: C_SNAPSTALL bit. If the processor is stalled on a load or store operation, a debugger can set this bit to 1 to attempt to break the stall. The effect of setting this bit to 1 is UNPREDICTABLE unless the DHCSR write also sets C_DEBUGEN and C_HALT to 1.This means that if the processor is not already in Debug statea it enters Debug state when the stalled instruction completes.Writing 1 to this bit makes the state of the memory system UNPREDICTABLE. Therefore, if a debugger writes 1 to this bit it must reset the processor before leaving Debug state.A Power-on reset sets this bit to 0.

enumeratedValue.name: C_SNAPSTALL_1
enumeratedValue.description: Attempt to force any stalled load or store instruction to complete.

field.name: S_REGRDY
field.description: S_REGRDY bit. A handshake flag for transfers through the DCRDR:- Writing to DCRSR clears the bit to 0.- Completion of the DCRDR transfer then sets the bit to 1.This bit is valid only when the processor is in Debug state, otherwise the bit is UNKNOWN.

enumeratedValue.name: S_REGRDY_0
enumeratedValue.description: There has been a write to the DCRDR, but the transfer is not complete.

enumeratedValue.name: S_REGRDY_1
enumeratedValue.description: The transfer to or from the DCRDR is complete.

field.name: S_HALT
field.description: S_HALT bit. Indicates whether the processor is in Debug state.

field.name: S_SLEEP
field.description: S_SLEEP bit. Indicates whether the processor is sleeping.The debugger must set the C_HALT bit to 1 to gain control, or wait for an interrupt or other wakeup event to wakeup the system.

field.name: S_LOCKUP
field.description: S_LOCKUP bit. Indicates whether the processor is locked up because of an unrecoverable exception.This bit can only be read as 1 by a remote debugger, using the DAP. The value of 1 indicates that the processor is running but locked up.The bit clears to 0 when the processor enters Debug state.

field.name: S_RETIRE_ST
field.description: S_RETIRE_ST bit. Indicates whether the processor has completed the execution of an instruction since the last read of DHCSR.This is a sticky bit, that clears to 0 on a read of DHCSR.A debugger can check this bit to determine if the processor is stalled on a load, store or fetch access.This bit is UNKNOWN after a Power-on or Local reset, but then is set to 1 as soon as the processor executes and retires an instruction.

enumeratedValue.name: S_RETIRE_ST_0
enumeratedValue.description: No instruction retired since last DHCSR read.

enumeratedValue.name: S_RETIRE_ST_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one instruction retired since last DHCSR read.

field.name: S_RESET_ST
field.description: S_RESET_ST bit. Indicates whether the processor has been reset since the last read of DHCSR.This is a sticky bit, that clears to 0 on a read of DHCSR.

enumeratedValue.name: S_RESET_ST_0
enumeratedValue.description: No reset since last DHCSR read.

enumeratedValue.name: S_RESET_ST_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one reset since last DHCSR read.

The effect of any attempt to change the value of this bit is UNPREDICTABLE unless both:- before the write to DHCSR, the value of the C_HALT bit is 1.- the write to the DHCSR that changes the C_MASKINTS bit also writes 1 to the C_HALT bit.This means that a single write to DHCSR cannot set the C_HALT to 0 and change the value of the C_MASKINTS bit.The bit does not affect NMI. When DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the value of this bit is UNKNOWN.This bit is UNKNOWN after a Power-on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: C_MASKINTS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Mask PenSV, SysTick and external configurable interrupts.

field.name: DBGKEY
field.description: Debug key:Software must write 0xA05F to this field to enable write accesses to bits [15:0], otherwise the processor ignores the write access.

field.name: REGSEL
field.description: REGSEL bits. Specifies the ARM core register, special-purpose register, or Floating-point extension register, to transfer.

field.name: REGWnR
field.description: REGWnR bit. Specifies the access type for the transfer.

field.name: DBGTMP
field.description: DBGTMP bits. Data temporary cache, for reading and writing the ARM core registers, special-purpose registers, and Floating-point extension registers.The value of this register is UNKNOWN:- on reset- if the processor is in Debug state, the debugger has written to DCRSR since entering Debug state and DHCSR.S_REGRDY is set to 0.

register.name: DEMCR
register.description: Debug Exception and Monitor Control Register

field.name: VC_CORERESET
field.description: VC_CORERESET bit. Enable Reset Vector Catch. This causes a Local reset to halt a running system.If DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the processor ignores the value of this bit.

field.name: VC_MMERR
field.description: VC_MMERR bit. Enable halting debug trap on a MemManage exception.If DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the processor ignores the value of this bit.

field.name: VC_NOCPERR
field.description: VC_NOCPERR bit. Enable halting debug trap on a UsageFault caused by an access to a Coprocessor.If DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the processor ignores the value of this bit.

field.name: VC_CHKERR
field.description: VC_CHKERR bit. Enable halting debug trap on a UsageFault exception caused by a checking error, for example an alignment check error.If DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the processor ignores the value of this bit.

field.name: VC_STATERR
field.description: VC_STATERR bit. Enable halting debug trap on a UsageFault exception caused by a state information error, for example an Undefined Instruction exception.If DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the processor ignores the value of this bit.

field.name: VC_BUSERR
field.description: VC_BUSERR bit. Enable halting debug trap on a BusFault exception.If DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the processor ignores the value of this bit.

field.name: VC_INTERR
field.description: VC_INTERR bit. Enable halting debug trap on a fault occurring during exception entry or exception return.If DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the processor ignores the value of this bit.

field.name: VC_HARDERR
field.description: VC_HARDERR bit. Enable halting debug trap on a HardFault exception.If DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the processor ignores the value of this bit.

field.name: MON_EN
field.description: MON_EN bit. Enable the DebugMonitor exception.If DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 1, the processor ignores the value of this bit.

field.name: MON_PEND
field.description: MON_PEND bit. Sets or clears the pending state of the DebugMonitor exception.When the DebugMonitor exception is pending it becomes active subject to the exception priority rules. A debugger can use this bit to wakeup the monitor using the DAP.The effect of setting this bit to 1 is not affected by the value of the MON_EN bit.A debugger can set MON_PEND to 1, and force the processor to take a DebugMonitor exception, even when MON_EN is set to 0.

enumeratedValue.name: MON_PEND_0
enumeratedValue.description: Clear the status of the DebugMonitor exception to not pending.

enumeratedValue.name: MON_PEND_1
enumeratedValue.description: Set the status of the DebugMonitor exception to pending.

field.name: MON_STEP
field.description: MON_STEP bit. When MON_EN is set to 0, this feature is disabled and the processor ignores MON_STEP.When MON_EN is set to 1, the meaning of MON_STEP is:0 = Do not step the processor.1 = Step the processor.Setting this bit to 1 makes the step request pending. The request becomes active when the processor returns from the DebugMonitor handler to the code being debugged. The effect of setting this bit to 1 is UNPREDICTABLE if the code being debugged is executing at an execution priority that is lower than the priority of the DebugMonitor exception.This is the debug monitor equivalent of DHCSR.C_STEP in Debug state.

field.name: MON_REQ
field.description: DebugMonitor semaphore bit. The processor does not use this bit. The monitor software defines the meaning and use of this bit.

field.name: TRCENA
field.description: TRCENA bit. Global enable for all DWT and ITM features.If the DWT and ITM blocks are not implemented, this bit is UNK/SBZP.When TRCENA is set to 0:- DWT registers return UNKNOWN values on reads. Whether the processor ignores writes to the DWT unit is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED.- ITM registers return UNKNOWN values on reads. Whether the processor ignores writes to the ITM unit is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED.Setting this bit to 0 might not stop all events. To ensure all events are stopped, software must set all DWT and ITM feature enable bits to 0, and then set this bit to 0.The effect of this bit on the TPIU, ETM, and other system trace components is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED.

field.name: SWIDTH
field.description: SWIDTH[N] represents a trace port width of (N+1). The meaning of each bit is:0 = Width (N+1) not supported.1 = Width (N+1) supported.

field.name: CWIDTH
field.description: CWIDTH[N] represents a trace port width of (N+1). The meaning of each bit is:0 = Width (N+1) is not the current trace port width.1 = Width (N+1) is the current trace port width.

field.name: TXMODE

field.name: FtStopped

field.name: TCPresent
field.description: TCPresent. This bit always reads zero

field.name: TrigIn

field.name: TRIGGER

field.name: NumberOfTraceInputs
